set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,subprocess
path='/opt/telegram-robot-leads'
cmd=[path+'/.venv/bin/python',path+'/scripts/telethon_sessions.py','--online','--vault','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads']
print('TELETHON_READONLY_ONLINE_CHECK_BEGIN',flush=True)
run=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=140,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
print('TELETHON_CHECK_EXIT',run.returncode)
try:
 data=json.loads(run.stdout)
 print('TELETHON_CHECK_STATUS',data.get('status'),'MODE',data.get('mode'),'API_SOURCE',data.get('api_source'))
 print('TELETHON_CHECK_ACCOUNT_COUNT',len(data.get('accounts',[])))
 for row in data.get('accounts',[]):
  print('ACCOUNT',row.get('account'),'status',row.get('status'),'connected',row.get('connected'),'authorized',row.get('authorized'),'identity_verified',row.get('identity_verified'),'phone_matches',row.get('phone_matches'),'error_type',row.get('error_type'))
 print('READ_ONLY_ASSERTIONS','messages_sent',data.get('messages_sent'),'users_added',data.get('users_added'),'session_files_modified',data.get('session_files_modified'))
except (ValueError,TypeError):
 print('INVALID_JSON_RESPONSE',type(run.stdout).__name__)
print('TELETHON_READONLY_ONLINE_CHECK_END')
if run.returncode!=0:raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
PY
